ITEM_GRAFT_BUNDLE_DESC: Kimp õunapuuoksi, vahaga kaetud otsad. Ootavad maad.
A bundle of apple scions, ends sealed with wax. Waiting for ground.
CP_GRAFTS_TRIGGER: Sa tõid pookoksad aastasse, kus keegi need istutas.
You brought the grafting stock to a year where somebody planted it.
CP_GRAFTS_EFFECT: Õunaaed kasvas. Hilisematel aastatel kannavad puud veel.
The orchard grew. In the later years the trees still bear.
EX_ORCHARD_KEPT: Old apple trees. A few still bear.
EX_ORCHARD_SCRUB: Võsa. Kunagi taheti siia midagi istutada.
Scrub. Somebody once meant to plant something here.

origin: + { not has_item("{ITEM}") and not flag("{FLAG}") } [Mis kimp see seal on? %% What is that bundle over there?]
Pookoksad. Mõisa aednik jättis. Meil ei ole aega ega maad. Võta, kui tahad. # en: Grafting stock. The manor's gardener left them. We have neither time nor ground. Take them if you like.
trigger: + { has_item("{ITEM}") and not flag("{FLAG}") } [Anna pookoksad. %% Hand over the grafting stock.]
Need on vanemad kui mina. Ja veel elus. # en: These are older than I am. And still alive.
Põllu serv. Homme hommikul. Enne kui keegi ütleb, et ei tasu. # en: The edge of the field. Tomorrow morning. Before anyone says it is not worth it.
+ { not has_item("{ITEM}") and not flag("{FLAG}") } [Kas siin õunapuid on? %% Are there apple trees here?]
Ei. Vanad räägivad, et mõisal oli pookoksi. Kadusid koos mõisaga. # en: No. The old people say the manor had grafting stock. It went with the manor.
later: Kolm puud kannavad veel. Igal sügisel vähem. Aga kannavad. # en: Three trees still bear. Fewer every autumn. But they bear.
